race.comment: DAGGERS (1) rewarded long-suffering supporters with a comprehensive all-the-way victory over this course and distance a fortnight ago. This looks no harder and after the claim he gets in with 1.5kgs less. Hard to tip against. PERFECT PLAY (6) has been racing well without winning in Saturday company in Sydney. Freshened up since a midfield finish over 1800m at Rosehill five weeks ago. Has a couple of hoof-related gear changes which are a little worrying, but on face value he is a winning hope. The consistent NORTH POLE (2) stalked the leader and tried hard but just missed over 1350m here recently. Draws the paint and is well in after the claim. Must be respected. JUST FLYING (10) is going well and has a liking for Doomben. A must for trifecta and first four players.
